test_title: PYST 19: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 12 Feb, 2025 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank and make the sentence meaningful.

My grandmother _______ to the temple alone last night.
solution:
The correct answer is '**went**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**went**" is the simple past tense form of the verb "**go**."
 
• The sentence describes an action that occurred in the past ("**last night**"), so the past tense "**went**" is required.
 
• **Options 1, 2**, and 3 are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"My grandmother **went**__ to the temple alone last night."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "is going"** is incorrect because it refers to an action happening in the present, not the past.
 
• **Option 2: "have gone"** is incorrect because it does not match the subject and tense of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3: "goes"** is incorrect because it refers to a habitual action, not a past action.
